player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-HighSociety (uhlobo lwe-2 kwa-madlali).
Mgidingo womdlalo:  Izikhadi ezishumi zesithunzi zitengwa ngamunye emuva kwamunye.
Ukutenga:    Emthengweni wonke, khetha ngokucopheleleyo ikhadi yemali 1-11 bese uyiveze.
            • Itengo eliphezulu linathinta ikhadi yesithunzi bese lithatha ikhadi leyo yemali.
            • Itengo eliphansi liyagcina ikhadi yalo yemali.
            • Itengo elilinganayo → amathengo omabili abuyiselwa bese ikhadi lesithunzi linye itengwe futhi.
Ukuphatha amaphuzu:    Emva kwemithengiso yezikhadi zishumi, ongeza **imali esalayo + amaphuzu esithunzi**.
            Inani eliphezulu *lenani lokuphatha* linathinta (itengo elilinganayo → umdlalo ungalungelwanga).

**Isintaksisi se-Action**  →  tshaja ikhadi iliyodwa njengaku '[7]' noma '[11]'.
